foundations.rationale: The generator exposes edits to an authentic synthesized signal while holding the visual sweep. The scope describes the source and selected note using actual PCM.

copy.rationale: Contributor notes describe the signed gains, paired Pulse coefficients, sampled data and settled edit behavior. Existing control labels and RPI naming are preserved.

interface.rationale: Loop and Reverse retain native checkbox semantics, keyboard focus and visible control states. Desktop and phone-width previews show the same fixed letterforms and existing color themes. The scope text is legible on the checked dark surface. Reduced motion still starts with Loop off.

bar-and-exports.rationale: Actual synthesized PCM drives a trace contained by the existing 250 by 18 reference viewport. The signal reflects about its phase origin while the note retains the same pitch and physical window. Editor, header, still exports and animated exports use the settled signal and existing geometry.

media.rationale: Audio Preview uses the app-synthesized carrier and finite gain ramps when reversing in place. The Video audio transition guidance is contextual. The change introduces no recorded media, production video, seal, spirit mark, gallery asset or email signature.

assets-and-approvals.rationale: Review PNGs show only the existing generator UI and its rendered Waveform mark from the two issue settings. They reuse the supplied geometry and existing fonts and UI. No external artwork, asset file, recording, new lockup or library submission is included. Existing rights questions remain recorded.

governance.rationale: No source, policy, approvals register, test gate or workflow change is involved.

existingConflicts.disposition: The decisions and rights questions in references/brand_conflicts.md remain open. The Waveform repair relies on the fixed source geometry and an already supported color composition.

approvalRationale: This repairs the existing Waveform signal and controls. The scope contains no new institutional asset, student club use, institutional lockup, official library submission or disputed treatment requiring a new brand decision.
publicationScope: Draft PR to tennitech/the-bar-generator for issues 208 and 218. It contains Waveform and cache revisions, tests, reference updates and three screenshots of the existing generator UI.

checks.name: brand-policy
checks.evidence: npm run check:brand validates the 36 captured source records, applicable review areas and fingerprint for this file state.

checks.name: unit-tests
checks.evidence: All 1,298 Jest tests in 107 suites pass on Node 22.23.5. Regression coverage includes paused and failed renders, a live fallback, frozen snapshots and reverse gain and Pulse coefficient scheduling.

checks.name: rendered-ui
checks.evidence: Chromium and WebKit passed Space and Arrow key edits at 1829 by 974. Both canvases change when paused edits settle and hold until Loop resumes. Emulated touch at 390 by 844 toggled Reverse in both directions with reduced motion and Loop off. The screenshots were visually inspected. The checked scope status contrast in Gray on Black is 9.12:1.

checks.name: audio-and-motion
checks.evidence: Both browser audio engines rendered six shapes and blends at A4. At 48 kHz, mirrored samples differ by at most 0.000253 around the shared phase origin. Mid-render direction edits settle to identical samples as an initial Reverse render. Real-time Web Audio and the scope worklet also settled and reported the new direction after a toggle.

checks.name: preview-export-parity
checks.evidence: Both browsers captured the current reversed PCM for export. Downloaded bar-only SVG matched the captured source. Decoded PNG pixels matched the SVG at the same scale. All 107 decoded GIF frames per browser matched the alpha coverage of the captured replay renderer.

checks.name: physical-device and listening checks
checks.evidence: Browser input and audio-engine output were verified in automation. Physical touch devices, native Safari delivery and subjective listening were not tested.

checks.name: user acceptance
checks.evidence: The owner has not explicitly confirmed testing this repair.
